Parliament Monsoon Session Begins Amidst Opposition Walkout and Legislative Agenda

India's Parliament is set to commence its Monsoon Session on July 20th, with the government planning to present its legislative agenda. An all-party meeting held prior saw an opposition walkout due to the presence of a breakaway Trinamool Congress faction. Several bills, including those related to MSME and income tax, are listed for introduction, while others like those concerning the removal of Prime Ministers and Chief Ministers appear deferred.
